$ archo deps
external dependencies
  todds:
    status: not installed
    error: todds is not installed
  steamcmd:
    status: installed
    path: $ROOT/LocalAppData/RimArcho/steamcmd/steamcmd.exe
    source: own

$ archo deps install unknown
error: unknown dependency "unknown" (known: [todds steamcmd])
usage: archo deps install <name>
[exit 2]

$ archo deps remove steamcmd
removed steamcmd

$ archo deps install
error: wrong number of arguments
usage: archo deps install <name>
[exit 2]
